# ig-design-system: every token

> Generated by `src/llms.ts` from `dist/tokens.json` and the two stylesheets on every build; do not edit it. The values are the defaults in the light variant. Start with [llms.txt](llms.txt) for the rules.

## Colour

- `--igd-color-accent-brand`: `{ig-info-seed}`. Brand accent: gradient start, icon tile fill, glow source. Not a CTA fill and never text on white. From the engine step `ig-info-seed`.
- `--igd-color-accent-brand-hover`: `{ig-info-400}`. `color-accent-brand` on hover. From the engine step `ig-info-400`. Follows `color-accent-brand` in the browser.
- `--igd-color-accent-brand-active`: `{ig-info-500}`. `color-accent-brand` while pressed. From the engine step `ig-info-500`. Follows `color-accent-brand` in the browser.
- `--igd-color-accent-ai`: `{ig-secondary-seed}`. Gradient partner to `color-accent-brand` and the AI marker. Never a fill on its own. From the engine step `ig-secondary-seed`.
- `--igd-color-accent-inverse-1`: `#51bbee`. The first accent for a dark area: stat numbers. Never on a light surface. Contrast 8.24:1 on `color-background-inverse`. From step 200 of the engine's sky palette, which the package does not publish.
- `--igd-color-accent-inverse-2`: `#3cc3b1`. The second accent for a dark area, beside `color-accent-inverse-1`: a second set of stat numbers. Never on a light surface. Contrast 8.19:1 on `color-background-inverse`. From step 200 of the engine's teal palette, which the package does not publish.
- `--igd-color-background-action`: `{ig-primary-seed}`. The fill of the main button and of every filled action. It is the primary seed itself, not a fitted shade. Its label is `color-foreground-on-action`. Text in the action colour is `color-foreground-action`. Contrast 5.25:1 on `color-background-page`. From the engine step `ig-primary-seed`.
- `--igd-color-foreground-link-hover`: `{ig-primary-700}`. A link on hover, on a light surface. The colour changes; no underline appears. Contrast 7.03:1 on `color-background-page`. From the engine step `ig-primary-700`. Follows `color-foreground-action` in the browser.
- `--igd-color-foreground-link-active`: `{ig-primary-800}`. A link while pressed, on a light surface. Contrast 8.8:1 on `color-background-page`. From the engine step `ig-primary-800`. Follows `color-foreground-action` in the browser.
- `--igd-color-background-action-hover`: `{ig-primary-700}`. The main button's fill on hover; nothing else about the button changes. A step `color-foreground-on-action` reads on: darker under a white label, primary step 400 under a black one. From the engine step `ig-primary-700`. Follows `color-background-action` in the browser.
- `--igd-color-foreground-action`: `{ig-primary-600}`. Text, an icon or a thin line in the action colour on a light surface: links, eyebrows, outline and ghost button labels, focus outlines. An engine step, which the engine solves to the same contrast for any seed. Contrast 5.24:1 on `color-background-page`, 4.82:1 on `color-background-tint`, 5.24:1 on `color-background-card`, 4.89:1 on `color-background-subtle`. From the engine step `ig-primary-600`.
- `--igd-color-foreground-link`: `{ig-primary-600}`. A link in text, on a light surface. The same steps as `color-foreground-action`, named for the link so a link reads it. Contrast 5.24:1 on `color-background-page`. From the engine step `ig-primary-600`.
- `--igd-color-foreground-on-action`: `#ffffff`. The label and icon on a `color-background-action` fill: black or white, whichever reads on it. Contrast 5.25:1 on `color-background-action`, 7.03:1 on `color-background-action-hover`. From the engine's adaptive contrast: white or black, whichever reads on `color-background-action`.
- `--igd-color-foreground-link-inverse`: `#51bbee`. Inline links on dark surfaces (`color-background-inverse`). Contrast 8.24:1 on `color-background-inverse`. From step 200 of the engine's sky palette, which the package does not publish.
- `--igd-color-foreground-link-inverse-hover`: `#95d5f7`. Hover of `color-foreground-link-inverse`: colour shift only. Contrast 11.17:1 on `color-background-inverse`. From step 100 of the engine's sky palette, which the package does not publish. Follows `color-foreground-link-inverse` in the browser.
- `--igd-footer-link-foreground`: `#d7dade`. Footer column links on the footer gradient. Contrast 11.07:1 on `color-background-inverse-raised`. From step 600 of the engine's dark gray palette, which the package does not publish. Follows `footer-foreground` in the browser.
- `--igd-color-focus-ring`: `{color-foreground-action}`. The keyboard focus ring on a light surface: `focus-ring-width` at `focus-ring-offset`, `:focus-visible` only. Contrast 5.24:1 on `color-background-page`. From the value of `color-foreground-action`.
- `--igd-color-focus-ring-inverse`: `#95d5f7`. The keyboard focus ring in an area that stays dark, such as the footer. `base.css` uses it inside an element with `data-on-dark`. Contrast 11.17:1 on `color-background-inverse`, 11.17:1 on `color-background-inverse`. From step 100 of the engine's sky palette, which the package does not publish. Follows `color-foreground-link-inverse` in the browser.
- `--igd-color-foreground-heading`: `{ig-gray-900}`. Headings, h1 to h6. Contrast 17.79:1 on `color-background-page`. From the engine step `ig-gray-900`.
- `--igd-color-foreground-default`: `{ig-gray-800}`. Body text: the default colour of the page's text, and the labels of secondary buttons. Contrast 13.8:1 on `color-background-page`. From the engine step `ig-gray-800`.
- `--igd-color-foreground-subtle`: `{ig-gray-600}`. Supporting text: the paragraph under a heading, the text of the utility bar, nav triggers at rest. Contrast 7.53:1 on `color-background-page`, 7.03:1 on `color-background-subtle`. From the engine step `ig-gray-600`.
- `--igd-color-foreground-control`: `{ig-gray-700}`. Text in controls: the nav, buttons, list rows, chips. Contrast 10.43:1 on `color-background-page`, 9.74:1 on `color-background-subtle`. From the engine step `ig-gray-700`.
- `--igd-color-foreground-faint`: `{ig-gray-500}`. Captions and small labels: card descriptions, counts. No body text is lighter than this. Contrast 4.94:1 on `color-background-page`, 4.62:1 on `color-background-subtle`, 4.94:1 on `color-background-card`, 4.55:1 on `color-background-tint`. From the engine step `ig-gray-500`.
- `--igd-color-foreground-inverse`: `#fbfbfb`. Text and icons on a dark area. Contrast 17.25:1 on `color-background-inverse`. From step 900 of the engine's dark gray palette, which the package does not publish.
- `--igd-color-foreground-inverse-faint`: `#9da5af`. Captions and small labels on a dark area. Contrast 7.17:1 on `color-background-inverse`. From step 400 of the engine's dark gray palette, which the package does not publish. Follows `color-foreground-inverse` in the browser.
- `--igd-color-foreground-decorative`: `{ig-gray-400}`. A decorative mark that carries no meaning, such as the caret in the nav row. It is lighter than 3:1 on purpose, so it never holds information. Contrast 2.59:1 on `color-background-page`. From the engine step `ig-gray-400`.
- `--igd-color-foreground-error`: `{ig-error-500}`. Validation text and border on light surfaces. Contrast 5.41:1 on `color-background-page`, 5.05:1 on `color-background-subtle`. From the engine step `ig-error-500`.
- `--igd-color-foreground-info`: `{ig-primary-700}`. Informational text and icons on light surfaces: a note, a tip. Contrast 7.03:1 on `color-background-page`, 6.47:1 on `color-background-tint`. From the engine step `ig-primary-700`.
- `--igd-color-foreground-warning-inverse`: `{ig-warn-200}`. Warning text and icons on dark surfaces. Contrast 8.23:1 on `color-background-inverse`. From the engine step `ig-warn-200`. Follows `color-foreground-warning` in the browser.
- `--igd-color-foreground-info-inverse`: `{ig-primary-300}`. Informational text and icons on dark surfaces. Contrast 9.59:1 on `color-background-inverse`. From the engine step `ig-primary-300`. Follows `color-foreground-info` in the browser.
- `--igd-color-foreground-success-inverse`: `{ig-success-300}`. Success icons on dark surfaces, such as a code block. Contrast 6.07:1 on `color-background-inverse`. From the engine step `ig-success-300`. Follows `color-foreground-success` in the browser.

- `--igd-color-background-page`: `{ig-surface-base}`. The page's background. From the engine step `ig-surface-base`.
- `--igd-color-background-subtle`: `{ig-surface-sunken}`. A quiet fill set apart from the page: a section band, a title bar, a chip or a Coming soon pill at rest, and the colour the wash behind the first section of a page starts from (`gradient-hero`). From the engine step `ig-surface-sunken`.
- `--igd-color-background-card`: `{ig-surface-raised}`. The fill of a card. From the engine step `ig-surface-raised`.
- `--igd-color-background-tint`: `{ig-primary-50}`. Soft blue fill: tinted chips, callouts, the catalog band, release strip at rest and monogram badges. From the engine step `ig-primary-50`. Follows `color-background-action` in the browser.
- `--igd-color-background-inverse-raised`: `#1c2435`. The lightest dark surface: where a dark area lifts towards the light, such as the start of the footer gradient. From step 200 of the engine's dark surface palette, which the package does not publish.

## Spacing

Two tiers. Steps (space-3xs … space-6xl) are the raw scale; the name is a size, not a pixel value, and the live value comes from the engine's pad() in theme.css, following --ig-spacing and --ig-size. Roles (space-inset-*, space-stack-*, space-gap-*) say what the space is for and are what components use.

- `--igd-space-3xs`: `0.125rem`. Raw spacing step. 2px at the default density.
- `--igd-space-2xs`: `0.25rem`. Raw spacing step. 4px at the default density.
- `--igd-space-xs`: `0.5rem`. Raw spacing step. 8px at the default density.
- `--igd-space-sm`: `0.75rem`. Raw spacing step. 12px at the default density.
- `--igd-space-md`: `1rem`. Raw spacing step. 16px at the default density.
- `--igd-space-lg`: `1.25rem`. Raw spacing step. 20px at the default density.
- `--igd-space-xl`: `1.5rem`. Raw spacing step. 24px at the default density.
- `--igd-space-2xl`: `2rem`. Raw spacing step. 32px at the default density.
- `--igd-space-3xl`: `2.5rem`. Raw spacing step. 40px at the default density.
- `--igd-space-4xl`: `3rem`. Raw spacing step. 48px at the default density.
- `--igd-space-5xl`: `4rem`. Raw spacing step. 64px at the default density.
- `--igd-space-6xl`: `6rem`. Raw spacing step. 96px at the default density.
- `--igd-space-inset-3xs`: `{space-3xs}`. Padding inside a container: the space between an edge and its content.
- `--igd-space-inset-2xs`: `{space-2xs}`. Padding inside a container: the space between an edge and its content.
- `--igd-space-inset-xs`: `{space-xs}`. Padding inside a container: the space between an edge and its content.
- `--igd-space-inset-sm`: `{space-sm}`. Padding inside a container: the space between an edge and its content.
- `--igd-space-inset-md`: `{space-md}`. Padding inside a container: the space between an edge and its content.
- `--igd-space-inset-lg`: `{space-lg}`. Padding inside a container: the space between an edge and its content.
- `--igd-space-inset-xl`: `{space-xl}`. Padding inside a container: the space between an edge and its content.
- `--igd-space-inset-2xl`: `{space-2xl}`. Padding inside a container: the space between an edge and its content.
- `--igd-space-inset-3xl`: `{space-3xl}`. Padding inside a container: the space between an edge and its content.
- `--igd-space-inset-4xl`: `{space-4xl}`. Padding inside a container: the space between an edge and its content.
- `--igd-space-inset-5xl`: `{space-5xl}`. Padding inside a container: the space between an edge and its content.
- `--igd-space-stack-3xs`: `{space-3xs}`. Vertical distance between elements stacked on top of each other (margins).
- `--igd-space-stack-2xs`: `{space-2xs}`. Vertical distance between elements stacked on top of each other (margins).
- `--igd-space-stack-xs`: `{space-xs}`. Vertical distance between elements stacked on top of each other (margins).
- `--igd-space-stack-sm`: `{space-sm}`. Vertical distance between elements stacked on top of each other (margins).
- `--igd-space-stack-md`: `{space-md}`. Vertical distance between elements stacked on top of each other (margins).
- `--igd-space-stack-lg`: `{space-lg}`. Vertical distance between elements stacked on top of each other (margins).
- `--igd-space-stack-xl`: `{space-xl}`. Vertical distance between elements stacked on top of each other (margins).
- `--igd-space-stack-2xl`: `{space-2xl}`. Vertical distance between elements stacked on top of each other (margins).
- `--igd-space-stack-3xl`: `{space-3xl}`. Vertical distance between elements stacked on top of each other (margins).
- `--igd-space-stack-4xl`: `{space-4xl}`. Vertical distance between elements stacked on top of each other (margins).
- `--igd-space-stack-5xl`: `{space-5xl}`. Vertical distance between elements stacked on top of each other (margins).
- `--igd-space-gap-3xs`: `{space-3xs}`. Distance between items that sit side by side or in a grid (gap, inline margins).
- `--igd-space-gap-2xs`: `{space-2xs}`. Distance between items that sit side by side or in a grid (gap, inline margins).
- `--igd-space-gap-xs`: `{space-xs}`. Distance between items that sit side by side or in a grid (gap, inline margins).
- `--igd-space-gap-sm`: `{space-sm}`. Distance between items that sit side by side or in a grid (gap, inline margins).

## Radius

Live values are produced by the engine's border-radius() in theme.css and follow --ig-radius-factor (unset = as listed, 0 = each role’s minimum, 1 = each role’s maximum).

- `--igd-radius-action`: `624.9375rem`. Every action, chip and framework selector. Fully round at any height today; never sharper than 4px. Range 4px to 9999px.
- `--igd-nav-panel-radius`: `1.875rem`. Flared top corners of an open nav panel. Range 0px to 30px.
- `--igd-radius-card-featured`: `1.5rem`. Emphasis and catalog cards. Never a circle: capped at 28px. Range 4px to 28px.
- `--igd-radius-card`: `1rem`. Marketing cards and media frames. Capped at 24px. Range 0px to 24px.
- `--igd-radius-tile`: `0.75rem`. Icon tiles, stat badges and nav link rows. Capped at 16px so a tile never becomes a circle. Range 4px to 16px.
- `--igd-radius-badge`: `0.5rem`. Small elements and the monogram badge. Range 2px to 12px.
- `--igd-radius-control`: `0.375rem`. OSS tag and checkbox. Range 2px to 8px.

## Size

Live values are produced by the engine's sizable() in theme.css and step down for --ig-size small and medium.

- `--igd-border-width-default`: `0.0625rem`. Hairline borders and dividers.
- `--igd-border-width-strong`: `0.0938rem`. Checkbox and gradient-border strokes.
- `--igd-focus-ring-width`: `0.1875rem`. Width of the `color-focus-ring` outline on `:focus-visible`.
- `--igd-focus-ring-offset`: `0.125rem`. Offset of the focus outline; the element itself never moves or changes fill on focus.
- `--igd-window-dot-size`: `0.6875rem`. BrowserFrame window dot.
- `--igd-size-icon-stroke`: `0.1375rem`. Stroke width of every `Icon` (viewBox units).
- `--igd-size-icon-stroke-strong`: `0.1875rem`. `Icon` weight="strong": check marks and close marks on a filled disc.
- `--igd-size-icon-xs`: `0.75rem`. Glyph in a comparison mark; caret in a trigger.
- `--igd-size-icon-sm`: `0.875rem`. Inline arrow in a link or a small control.
- `--igd-size-icon-md`: `1rem`. Default icon and checkbox box.
- `--igd-size-icon-lg`: `1.25rem`. Nav icon button glyph; comparison mark circle.
- `--igd-size-control-sm`: `2.25rem`. Icon button and social button.
- `--igd-size-control-md`: `2.5rem`. Navigation CTA, pill field and its button, compliance seals.
- `--igd-size-control-lg`: `2.75rem`. Stacked field and its button.
- `--igd-size-control-xl`: `3rem`. Minimum accordion row height on mobile.
- `--igd-nav-height`: `4.375rem`. Navigation bar minimum height.
- `--igd-badge-mono-size`: `2rem`. Monogram badge box.
- `--igd-size-tile`: `2.75rem`. Icon tile box.
- `--igd-fw-logo-height`: `1rem`. Framework logo inside a pill.
- `--igd-logo-height`: `1.5rem`. Header and footer wordmark.
- `--igd-product-logo-height`: `1.625rem`. Product logo in a catalog card.
- `--igd-product-logo-max-width`: `10rem`. Product logo maximum width.
- `--igd-stat-badge-offset`: `1.125rem`. How far a floating stat badge overhangs its frame.
- `--igd-stat-badge-inset`: `1.5rem`. Inset of a bottom-anchored stat badge.
- `--igd-glow-size-lg`: `47.5rem`. Footer glow, large.
- `--igd-glow-size-md`: `40rem`. Footer glow, medium.
- `--igd-field-min-width`: `13.75rem`. Minimum width of a flexible field.
- `--igd-callout-min-width`: `13.75rem`. Minimum width of the copy block in a callout.
- `--igd-callout-max-width`: `67.5rem`. Maximum width of the release strip.
- `--igd-newsletter-min-width`: `20rem`. Minimum column width in the newsletter block.
- `--igd-footer-column-min-width`: `11.25rem`. Minimum footer column width.
- `--igd-nav-panel-max-width`: `80rem`. Default nav panel maximum width.
- `--igd-bleed-width`: `73.75rem`. Content width a bleeding frame measures against.
- `--igd-container-max-width`: `80rem`. Max content width.
- `--igd-container-hero-max-width`: `70rem`. Max width of hero text.
- `--igd-container-prose-max-width`: `55rem`. Max width of prose.
- `--igd-catalog-card-min-width`: `21.25rem`. Min card width in the catalog grid: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(var(--igd-catalog-card-min-width), 1fr)).
- `--igd-letter-spacing-label`: `0.12em`. Uppercase table and column headers.
- `--igd-letter-spacing-badge`: `0.04em`. Uppercase badges.
- `--igd-letter-spacing-mono`: `0.02em`. Monogram badge.

## Shadow

`shadow-card-hover`, `shadow-screenshot`, `shadow-floating`, `shadow-popover`, `shadow-panel` and `shadow-chip` are the shadows www.infragistics.com ships, compiled with the engine's box-shadow(). The rest are resolved from igniteui-theming elevations (indigo preset) at --ig-elevation-factor 1; tinted levels use the same preset with `color-background-action` as umbra, penumbra and ambient colour. theme.css keeps them live.

- `--igd-shadow-none`: `none`. Cards at rest — flat; a card is defined by its hairline `color-border-default`. Engine elevation 0.
- `--igd-shadow-card-hover`: `0 10px 30px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 4px 10px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)`. Card hover: cards lift shadow only, no translate or scale.
- `--igd-shadow-action-lg`: `0 8px 10px -5px rgba(36,98,234,0.26), 0 16px 24px 2px rgba(36,98,234,0.12), 0 6px 30px 5px rgba(36,98,234,0.08)`. Primary CTA and its hover (no shadow change on hover). Engine elevation 16 tinted with `color-background-action`.
- `--igd-shadow-action-sm`: `0 1px 3px 0 rgba(36,98,234,0.26), 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(36,98,234,0.12), 0 2px 1px -1px rgba(36,98,234,0.08)`. Framework pill hover — the only hover change on a pill. Engine elevation 1 tinted with `color-background-action`.
- `--igd-shadow-screenshot`: `0 44px 90px -34px rgba(15,23,42,0.4)`. Screenshots inside a BrowserFrame.
- `--igd-shadow-floating`: `0 16px 32px -12px rgba(15,23,42,0.4)`. Floating stat badges.
- `--igd-shadow-action-md`: `0 7px 8px -4px rgba(36,98,234,0.26), 0 13px 19px 2px rgba(36,98,234,0.12), 0 5px 24px 4px rgba(36,98,234,0.08)`. Bundle cards with the gradient border. Engine elevation 13 tinted with `color-background-action`.
- `--igd-callout-release-shadow`: `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,153,255,0.12), 0 7px 8px -4px rgba(36,98,234,0.26), 0 13px 19px 2px rgba(36,98,234,0.12), 0 5px 24px 4px rgba(36,98,234,0.08)`. Release strip at rest. Engine elevation 13 tinted with `color-background-action`.
- `--igd-callout-release-shadow-hover`: `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,153,255,0.25), 0 8px 10px -5px rgba(36,98,234,0.26), 0 16px 24px 2px rgba(36,98,234,0.12), 0 6px 30px 5px rgba(36,98,234,0.08)`. Release strip on hover. Engine elevation 16 tinted with `color-background-action`.
- `--igd-shadow-chip`: `0 24px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)`. Dark glass chips over a screenshot, with `color-background-inverse-overlay`.
- `--igd-shadow-popover`: `0 26px 50px -22px rgba(15,23,42,0.22)`. Dropdown menus and popovers.
- `--igd-shadow-panel`: `0 -2px 8px 0 rgba(15,23,42,0.04), 0 18px 40px -12px rgba(15,23,42,0.28), 0 40px 80px -24px rgba(15,23,42,0.3)`. Open nav panel.
- `--igd-shadow-popover-filter`: `drop-shadow(0 10px 13px rgba(0,0,0,0.26)) drop-shadow(0 20px 31px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)) drop-shadow(0 8px 38px rgba(0,0,0,0.08))`. Open nav panel — the flared panel outline needs a `filter`, so this is engine elevation 20 expressed as drop-shadow() layers (spread dropped).
- `--igd-elevation-0`: `none`. Engine elevation 0, indigo preset.
- `--igd-elevation-1`: `0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.26), 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.12), 0 2px 1px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)`. Engine elevation 1, indigo preset.

## Opacity

Alpha steps for translucent colours; combined with a colour token as hsl(from <colour> h s l / <opacity>).

- `--igd-opacity-faint`: `0.04`. Barely-there tint.
- `--igd-opacity-subtle`: `0.08`. Soft fills and hairlines.
- `--igd-opacity-soft`: `0.12`. Tag fills and inner rings.
- `--igd-opacity-muted`: `0.16`. Glows and control borders.
- `--igd-opacity-strong`: `0.25`. Capsule borders and scrims.
- `--igd-opacity-heavy`: `0.4`. Emphasis borders and strong glows.
- `--igd-opacity-field`: `0.6`. Input fill on the dark footer.
- `--igd-opacity-chip`: `0.82`. Dark chips over a screenshot.
- `--igd-opacity-nav`: `0.96`. Sticky nav background.
- `--igd-opacity-disabled`: `0.45`. Disabled controls.

## Font weight

- `--igd-font-weight-regular`: `400`. Font weight 400.
- `--igd-font-weight-medium`: `500`. Font weight 500.
- `--igd-font-weight-semibold`: `600`. Font weight 600.
- `--igd-font-weight-bold`: `700`. Font weight 700.
- `--igd-font-weight-extrabold`: `800`. Font weight 800.
- `--igd-font-weight-black`: `900`. Font weight 900.

## Gradient

Gradients and ambient glows. Three uses only: clipped headline text, the hero wash and glows, and the footer.

- `--igd-footer-background-gradient`: `linear-gradient(155deg, #1c2435 0%, #121a2c 42%, #070e1d 100%)`. The site footer’s own 155° gradient — one of the two dark surfaces in the system.
- `--igd-gradient-brand`: `linear-gradient(92deg, #0099ff, #9810fa)`. The 92° blue→violet, clipped to one headline fragment per section. Never a background fill, button or tile.
- `--igd-gradient-hero`: `linear-gradient(180deg, #f7f7f7, #ffffff)`. The hero wash behind the homepage hero.
- `--igd-glow-brand`: `radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0,153,255,0.16), transparent 62%)`. Ambient radial glow behind hero and section content, bleeding off the edges, `pointer-events:none`.
- `--igd-glow-ai`: `radial-gradient(circle, rgba(152,16,250,0.16), transparent 62%)`. Ambient radial glow partnered with `glow-brand` on light sections.
- `--igd-glow-footer`: `radial-gradient(circle, rgba(152,16,250,0.4), transparent 62%)`. Footer glow only (top-right of the dark footer).
- `--igd-glow-inverse`: `radial-gradient(circle, rgba(226,59,143,0.16), transparent 62%)`. Ambient glow for the dark AI and enterprise bands only.
- `--igd-glow-inverse-partner`: `radial-gradient(circle, rgba(60,195,177,0.12), transparent 68%)`. Ambient glow for the dark AI and enterprise bands and the footer.

## Breakpoint

The layout only changes at these four; the container is fluid between them.

- `--igd-breakpoint-sm`: `640px`. Two-up copy/media splits stack; footer collapses to accordions; catalog drops to one column.
- `--igd-breakpoint-md`: `768px`. Nav collapses to a menu button; the utility bar hides.
- `--igd-breakpoint-lg`: `1024px`. Feature grid goes 3-up → 2-up; the nav items collapse to a menu.
- `--igd-breakpoint-xl`: `1280px`. Container reaches full width; the gutter stops growing; secondary nav links hide below it.

## Layer

Eight named layers — never write a raw z-index.

- `--igd-z-index-base`: `1`. Section content sitting above an ambient glow.
- `--igd-z-index-raised`: `2`. Full-card link overlays; the footer above a card body.
- `--igd-z-index-media`: `3`. Floating stat badges over a browser frame.
- `--igd-z-index-lift`: `5`. The G2 card that straddles two bands.
- `--igd-z-index-sticky`: `40`. Sticky filter bar on the catalog and the nav scrim.
- `--igd-z-index-nav`: `50`. The site header. Nothing in page content may exceed this.
- `--igd-z-index-panel`: `60`. Nav dropdown panels.
- `--igd-z-index-overlay`: `100`. Anything modal.

## Type roles

Each role has `--igd-type-<role>-font-family`, `-font-size`, `-font-weight`, `-line-height`, `-letter-spacing` and `-text-transform`, and the class `.igd-type-<role>`.

- `display-lg`: 3.25rem, fluid from 2.25rem, line height 1.12, weight 900; 2.25rem in the docs set. Homepage hero only, in `color-foreground-heading`. Engine slot `h1`.
- `display-md`: 2.6875rem, fluid from 1.875rem, line height 1.06, weight 800; 1.5rem in the docs set. Section heads, in `color-foreground-heading`. Engine slot `h2`.
- `display-sm`: 1.4375rem, fluid from 1.25rem, line height 1.2, weight 800; 1.25rem in the docs set. Sub-section and panel heads; `color-foreground-inverse` on dark. There is no h7. Engine slot `h3`.
- `stat`: 1.625rem, line height 1.1, weight 800; 1.125rem in the docs set. Stat badge values: `color-accent-inverse-1` or `color-accent-inverse-2` on `color-background-inverse`, `color-foreground-faint` on light; newsletter title. Engine slot `h4`.
- `title-md`: 1.125rem, line height 1.3, weight 800; 1rem in the docs set. Product names in a catalog card, in `color-foreground-heading`. Engine slot `h5`.
- `title-sm`: 1rem, line height 1.4, weight 600; 0.875rem in the docs set. Card titles, sentence case, in `color-foreground-heading` — body face, not the display face. Engine slot `h6`.
- `lead`: 1.1875rem, fluid from 1.0625rem, line height 1.6, weight 400; 1rem in the docs set. Lead under an h1 or h2, in `color-foreground-subtle`. Engine slot `subtitle-1`.
- `label-lg`: 1.0625rem, line height 1.5, weight 700; 0.875rem in the docs set. Hero button label and callout titles. Engine slot `subtitle-2`.
- `body-lg`: 1rem, line height 1.62, weight 400; 1rem in the docs set. Running prose, in `color-foreground-subtle`. Engine slot `body-1`.
- `body-md`: 0.9375rem, line height 1.5, weight 400; 0.875rem in the docs set. Nav, buttons and list rows, in `color-foreground-control`. Engine slot `body-2`.
- `label-md`: 0.9375rem, line height 1.5, weight 600; 1rem in the docs set. Button and CTA labels. Engine slot `button`.
- `body-sm`: 0.875rem, line height 1.55, weight 400; 0.75rem in the docs set. Captions, card descriptions and table detail copy. Engine slot `caption`.
- `eyebrow`: 0.75rem, line height 1.5, weight 600; 0.625rem in the docs set. Eyebrows: ALL CAPS, in `color-foreground-action`. Engine slot `overline`.
- `body-xs`: 0.8125rem, line height 1.5, weight 400; 0.8125rem in the docs set. Micro text: utility bar, legal copy, chips.
- `body-2xs`: 0.6875rem, line height 1.4, weight 400; 0.8125rem in the docs set. Badge sublabels and nano meta labels (`color-foreground-faint`).

## Declared in the stylesheets only

Custom properties of `tokens.css` and `theme.css` that have no entry in `tokens.json`, with their first value.

- `--igd-font-display`: `'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif`
- `--igd-font-body`: `'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif`
- `--igd-font-mono`: `'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace`
- `--igd-color-shadow`: `oklch(0 0 0)`
- `--igd-easing-default`: `cubic-bezier(0.215, 0.61, 0.355, 1)`
- `--igd-component-size`: `var(--ig-size, var(--ig-size-large))`
- `--igd-is-large`: `clamp(0, (var(--igd-component-size, 1) + 1) - var(--ig-size-large, 3), 1)`
- `--igd-is-medium`: `min( clamp(0, (var(--igd-component-size, 1) + 1) - var(--ig-size-medium, 2), 1), clamp(0, var(--ig-size-large, 3) - var(--igd-component-size, 1), 1) )`
- `--igd-is-small`: `clamp(0, var(--ig-size-medium, 2) - var(--igd-component-size, 1), 1)`
- `--igd-gradient-border-bundle`: `linear-gradient(var(--igd-color-background-card), var(--igd-color-background-card)) padding-box, linear-gradient(135deg, var(--igd-color-accent-brand), var(--igd-color-accent-ai)) border-box`
- `--igd-gradient-emphasis`: `linear-gradient(180deg, hsl(from var(--igd-color-accent-brand) h s l / var(--igd-opacity-subtle)), hsl(from var(--igd-color-accent-inverse-1) h s l / var(--igd-opacity-faint)))`
- `--igd-footer-card-background`: `linear-gradient(180deg, hsl(from var(--igd-color-foreground-inverse) h s l / var(--igd-opacity-faint)), transparent)`
- `--igd-container-gutter`: `clamp(var(--igd-space-lg), 4vw, var(--igd-space-4xl))`
- `--igd-space-section`: `clamp(var(--igd-space-5xl), calc(3.4783cqi + 3.2174rem), var(--igd-space-6xl))`
- `--igd-layout-split`: `0.95fr 1.05fr`
- `--igd-nav-backdrop-blur`: `blur(var(--igd-space-sm))`
- `--igd-duration-chip`: `140ms`
- `--igd-duration-fast`: `160ms`
- `--igd-duration-button`: `180ms`
- `--igd-duration-slow`: `320ms`
